<!DOCTYPE html>
<!--
  Template used by build-standalone.ps1 to produce uploader.html.

  The flasher is self-contained inside the firmware/ folder: the site-wide
  css/style.css, css/uploader.css, js/theme.js and js/reveal.js are inlined
  into the final HTML at build time, so uploader.html no longer depends on
  anything outside firmware/. Only files living next to it are required
  (uploader.js, esptool.js, bootloader.bin, partitions.bin, esp32.bin).

  Do NOT edit uploader.html directly — edit this template and re-run:
      powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File firmware/build-standalone.ps1
-->
<html lang="ru">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="description" content="Прошивка Open ESP32-C3 прямо из браузера — через esptool.js и Web Serial.">
  <title>Прошивка · Open Battery Information</title>
  <style>
/* Shared design system for the Open Battery Information web app. */
:root {
  --bg: #1e1f22;
  --bg-elevated: #2b2d31;
  --bg-input: #232428;
  --bg-code: #141517;
  --border: #3f4147;
  --border-strong: #2c2e33;
  --text: #e8e9eb;
  --text-dim: #9aa0a6;
  --accent: #4f9cf9;
  --accent-hover: #6db0ff;
  --danger: #e5534b;
  --ok: #57ab5a;
  --warn: #d29922;
  --hover-bg: #33353b;
  --hover-border: #55575f;
  --row-alt: #242529;
  --row-hover: #2a2c31;
  --row-selected: #1b3a5c;
  --feature-tint: #3a2c16;
  --log-ok: #9ece6a;
  --log-err: #f7768e;
  --log-warn: #e0af68;
  --log-send: #7aa2f7;
  --radius: 8px;
  --radius-lg: 12px;
  --font-mono: "Cascadia Code", "Consolas", "Menlo", monospace;
}

[data-theme="light"] {
  --bg: #f3f4f6;
  --bg-elevated: #ffffff;
  --bg-input: #e8eaee;
  --bg-code: #fafbfc;
  --border: #d0d4da;
  --border-strong: #d0d4da;
  --text: #1f2328;
  --text-dim: #5f6b76;
  --accent: #2f81f7;
  --accent-hover: #1f6feb;
  --danger: #d1242f;
  --ok: #1a7f37;
  --warn: #9a6700;
  --hover-bg: #e2e5ea;
  --hover-border: #b6bcc4;
  --row-alt: #f0f2f5;
  --row-hover: #e2e5ea;
  --row-selected: #d5e6fc;
  --feature-tint: #fdf2da;
  --log-ok: #1a7f37;
  --log-err: #d1242f;
  --log-warn: #9a6700;
  --log-send: #1f6feb;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }

html, body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  min-height: 100%;
}

body {
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

/* ---------- Navbar ---------- */
.navbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 20px;
  height: 56px;
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.navbar .brand {
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15px;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--text);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.navbar .brand .accent { color: var(--accent); }

.nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }

.nav-links a {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  text-decoration: none;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.nav-links a:hover { background: var(--bg-input); color: var(--text); }

.nav-links a.active { color: var(--text); background: var(--bg-input); }

.nav-links a .nav-badge {
  margin-left: 6px;
}

/* ---------- Buttons ---------- */
button {
  background: var(--bg-input);
  color: var(--text);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 9px 16px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.12s, border-color 0.12s, transform 0.05s;
}

button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--hover-bg); border-color: var(--hover-border); }
button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); }

button:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

button.primary,
button.btn-primary {
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: #0b1220;
}

button.primary:hover:not(:disabled),
button.btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-hover); }

button.danger { background: var(--danger); border-color: var(--danger); color: #fff; }
button.success { background: var(--ok); border-color: var(--ok); color: #fff; }

button.btn-secondary { background: var(--bg-elevated); }
button.btn-ghost { background: transparent; }
button.btn-lg { padding: 13px 26px; font-size: 16px; }
button.btn-block { width: 100%; }

/* ---------- Forms ---------- */
select, input[type="text"], input[type="number"], input[type="checkbox"], input[type="file"] {
  background: var(--bg-input);
  color: var(--text);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  font-size: 14px;
}

select { width: 100%; }

select:focus, input:focus {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 1px;
}

label.checkbox {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  margin: 6px 0;
}

.field {
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.field > label {
  display: block;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.field .hint { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim); margin-top: 6px; }

/* ---------- Status / badges ---------- */
.badge {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--text-dim);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.badge.ok { color: var(--ok); border-color: var(--ok); }
.badge.busy { color: var(--warn); border-color: var(--warn); }
.badge.err { color: var(--danger); border-color: var(--danger); }

.status-line { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-dim); }
.status-line b { color: var(--text); font-weight: 600; }

/* ---------- Modal ---------- */
.modal-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 100;
}

.modal {
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  max-width: 480px;
  width: 92%;
  padding: 20px 22px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}

.modal h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 16px; }
.modal p { margin: 0 0 16px; color: var(--text-dim); line-height: 1.5; white-space: pre-wrap; }
.modal .modal-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 10px; }

/* ---------- Toasts ---------- */
.toast-container {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 20px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  z-index: 200;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.toast {
  background: var(--glass-strong);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok) 60%, transparent);
  color: var(--text);
  padding: 10px 18px;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
  transition: opacity 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease;
}

.toast.toast-error { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 60%, transparent); }
.toast.toast-out { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }

/* ---------- Card ---------- */
.card {
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 18px 20px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.card h2 {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: var(--text-dim);
}

/* ---------- Progress ---------- */
.progress-track {
  height: 10px;
  background: var(--bg-input);
  border-radius: 5px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 12px 0 4px;
}

.progress-track .bar {
  height: 100%;
  width: 0%;
  background: var(--accent);
  transition: width 0.15s;
}

.theme-toggle {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--text-dim);
  padding: 6px 10px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.theme-toggle:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--hover-border); }

.theme-toggle svg {
  display: block;
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
}

/* Navbar icon link (GitHub) */
.nav-links a.nav-icon {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  padding: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--glass);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  color: var(--text-dim);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}

.nav-links a.nav-icon:hover {
  background: var(--glass);
  border-color: var(--accent-2);
  color: var(--accent-2);
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px var(--glow-1);
}

.nav-links a.nav-icon svg {
  display: block;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
}

/* Burger toggle (hidden on desktop, shown on small screens) */
.nav-toggle {
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  padding: 0;
  margin-left: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--glass);
  color: var(--text-dim);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.nav-toggle:hover { border-color: var(--accent-2); color: var(--accent-2); }

.nav-toggle svg {
  display: block;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
}

@media (max-width: 860px) {
  .nav-toggle { display: inline-flex; }

  .nav-links {
    position: absolute;
    top: 56px;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    display: none;
    background: var(--glass-strong);
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 70%, transparent);
    box-shadow: 0 24px 40px -24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
    padding: 8px 12px 14px;
  }

  .navbar.nav-open .nav-links { display: flex; }

  .nav-links a { padding: 12px 12px; }

  .nav-links .theme-toggle,
  .nav-links a.nav-icon { align-self: flex-end; margin-top: 6px; }
}

/* Sun icon (shown in dark mode: clicking switches to light) / moon for light. */
.theme-toggle .icon-moon { display: none; }
.theme-toggle .icon-sun { display: block; }
[data-theme="light"] .theme-toggle .icon-moon { display: block; }
[data-theme="light"] .theme-toggle .icon-sun { display: none; }

/* ---------- Utilities ---------- */
.muted { color: var(--text-dim); }
.mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); }
.text-center { text-align: center; }
.mt-0 { margin-top: 0; }
.mt-1 { margin-top: 8px; }
.mt-2 { margin-top: 16px; }
.mb-0 { margin-bottom: 0; }
.mb-1 { margin-bottom: 8px; }
.mb-2 { margin-bottom: 16px; }
.flex { display: flex; }
.flex-col { flex-direction: column; }
.gap-1 { gap: 8px; }
.gap-2 { gap: 16px; }
.items-center { align-items: center; }
.justify-between { justify-content: space-between; }
.flex-wrap { flex-wrap: wrap; }

.container {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1000px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 24px;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
}

/* ============================================================
   Aurora / glass UI layer (ui-flashy branch, exploratory).
   Everything above the "Flashy UI" marker below is the original
   design; this section layers a richer look on top of it.
   ============================================================ */

:root {
  --accent-1: #38bdf8;
  --accent-2: #818cf8;
  --accent-3: #c084fc;
  --grad: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--accent-1), var(--accent-2), var(--accent-3));
  --grad-soft: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.22), rgba(129, 140, 248, 0.22), rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.22));
  --glass: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-elevated) 74%, transparent);
  --glass-strong: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-elevated) 88%, transparent);
  --glow-1: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
  --glow-2: rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.35);
  --radius-xl: 16px;
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

[data-theme="light"] {
  --accent-1: #0891b2;
  --accent-2: #4f46e5;
  --accent-3: #a21caf;
  --grad-soft: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(8, 145, 178, 0.16), rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.16), rgba(162, 28, 175, 0.14));
  --glass: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-elevated) 80%, transparent);
  --glass-strong: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-elevated) 92%, transparent);
  --glow-1: rgba(8, 145, 178, 0.22);
  --glow-2: rgba(162, 28, 175, 0.18);
}

html { scrollbar-color: var(--hover-border) transparent; }

::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 10px; height: 10px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--border), var(--hover-border));
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  background-clip: padding-box;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--hover-border); }

::selection { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2) 35%, transparent); }

body {
  background:
    radial-gradient(90rem 90rem at 110% -10%, var(--glow-2), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(80rem 80rem at -10% 15%, var(--glow-1), transparent 55%),
    var(--bg);
}

body::before,
body::after {
  content: "";
  position: fixed;
  z-index: -1;
  width: 46vmax;
  height: 46vmax;
  border-radius: 50%;
  filter: blur(80px);
  opacity: 0.32;
  pointer-events: none;
  will-change: transform;
}

body::before {
  top: -14vmax;
  left: -12vmax;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--accent-1), transparent 62%);
  animation: aurora-a 28s var(--ease-out) infinite alternate;
}

body::after {
  bottom: -16vmax;
  right: -14vmax;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--accent-3), transparent 62%);
  animation: aurora-b 36s var(--ease-out) infinite alternate;
}

[data-theme="light"] body::before,
[data-theme="light"] body::after { opacity: 0.2; }

@keyframes aurora-a {
  0%   { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
  50%  { transform: translate(7vmax, 5vmax) scale(1.18); }
  100% { transform: translate(-3vmax, 9vmax) scale(0.92); }
}

@keyframes aurora-b {
  0%   { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
  50%  { transform: translate(-8vmax, -6vmax) scale(1.22); }
  100% { transform: translate(4vmax, -10vmax) scale(0.9); }
}

@keyframes grad-pan { to { background-position: 220% 0; } }

/* ---------- Navbar ---------- */
.navbar {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 50;
  background: var(--glass-strong);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.5);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.5);
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 70%, transparent);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}

.navbar .brand { font-size: 16px; }

.navbar .brand .accent {
  background: var(--grad);
  background-size: 220% 100%;
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
  animation: grad-pan 9s linear infinite;
}

.nav-links a { position: relative; transition: color 0.2s ease; }
.nav-links a:hover { background: transparent; }
.nav-links a.active { background: transparent; }

.nav-links a::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 12px;
  right: 12px;
  bottom: 5px;
  height: 2px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--grad);
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform 0.3s var(--ease-out);
}

.nav-links a:hover::after,
.nav-links a.active::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

/* ---------- Buttons ---------- */
button {
  transition: background 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease,
    transform 0.12s ease, color 0.18s ease;
}

button.primary,
button.btn-primary {
  background: var(--grad);
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  border: none;
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 8px 22px -8px var(--glow-1);
  transition: background-position 0.45s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
}

button.primary:hover:not(:disabled),
button.btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background-position: 100% 0;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2), 0 12px 30px -10px var(--glow-2);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

button.danger {
  box-shadow: 0 8px 22px -10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 55%, transparent);
}

button.success {
  box-shadow: 0 8px 22px -10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok) 55%, transparent);
}

.theme-toggle {
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  padding: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--glass);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  justify-content: center;
}

.theme-toggle:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: var(--accent-2);
  color: var(--accent-2);
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px var(--glow-1);
}

/* ---------- Cards ---------- */
.card {
  background: linear-gradient(var(--glass-strong), var(--glass-strong)) padding-box,
    var(--grad-soft) border-box;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}

/* ---------- Badges ---------- */
.badge {
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--glass);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  border-color: transparent;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border);
}

.badge.ok {
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok) 55%, transparent);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok) 12%, transparent);
}

.badge.busy {
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 55%, transparent);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 12%, transparent);
}

.badge.err {
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 55%, transparent);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 12%, transparent);
}

/* ---------- Modal ---------- */
.modal {
  background: linear-gradient(var(--glass-strong), var(--glass-strong)) padding-box,
    var(--grad-soft) border-box;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  box-shadow: 0 24px 70px -28px var(--glow-1);
}

/* ---------- Progress ---------- */
.progress-track { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-input) 80%, transparent); }

.progress-track .bar {
  background: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px var(--glow-1);
}

/* ---------- Log / inputs ---------- */
select,
input[type="text"],
input[type="number"],
input[type="checkbox"],
input[type="file"] {
  background: var(--glass);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

select:focus,
input:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--glow-1); }

/* ---------- Reveal-on-scroll (driven by js/reveal.js) ---------- */
html.js-reveal .reveal {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(22px);
  will-change: opacity, transform;
}

html.js-reveal .reveal.revealed {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
  transition: opacity 0.7s var(--ease-out), transform 0.7s var(--ease-out);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html.js-reveal .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
  .navbar .brand .accent,
  .progress-track .bar,
  body::before,
  body::after { animation: none; }
}

/* Firmware uploader (single-button wizard) styles. */
.uploader-wrap {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 760px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 24px;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
}

.uploader-header { margin-bottom: 20px; }
.uploader-header h1 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 26px; }
.uploader-header .subtitle { color: var(--text-dim); margin: 0; }

.flash-card {
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 24px;
}

/* flow steps */
.flash-flow {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.flow-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex: 0 0 auto; }

.flow-dot {
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--text-dim);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 12px;
  background: var(--bg-input);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.flow-item .flow-label { font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 13px; }

.flow-item.active .flow-dot { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent); color: #0b1220; }
.flow-item.active .flow-label { color: var(--text); }
.flow-item.done .flow-dot { border-color: var(--ok); background: var(--ok); color: #0b1220; }
.flow-item.done .flow-label { color: var(--ok); }

.flow-connector { flex: 1 1 auto; height: 2px; background: var(--border); min-width: 20px; }
.flow-item.done + .flow-connector { background: var(--ok); }

/* board selector */
.board-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}

.board-option {
  display: block;
  background: var(--bg-input);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 14px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.12s, background 0.12s;
}

.board-option:hover { border-color: var(--hover-border); }
.board-option.selected { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--row-selected); }

.board-option input { display: none; }

.board-option .board-name { font-weight: 700; display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.board-option .board-desc { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim); }

/* firmware source */
.firmware-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.firmware-row .hint { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim); margin-top: 6px; }

/* flash area */
.flash-area { margin-top: 8px; }

.flash-status {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  min-height: 40px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.flash-status .status-text { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; }
.flash-status .status-text.err { color: var(--danger); }
.flash-status .status-text.ok { color: var(--ok); }

.spinner {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border: 3px solid var(--border);
  border-top-color: var(--accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

.flash-done-msg {
  margin-top: 16px;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ok);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok) 12%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok) 45%, transparent);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 12px 18px;
}

.flash-done-msg[hidden] { display: none; }

.requirements-note {
  margin-top: 16px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  text-align: center;
}

.requirements-note a { color: var(--accent); }

/* ============================================================
   Aurora / glass UI layer: firmware uploader (ui-flashy branch).
   ============================================================ */
.flash-card {
  background: linear-gradient(var(--glass-strong), var(--glass-strong)) padding-box,
    var(--grad-soft) border-box;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  box-shadow: 0 18px 50px -28px var(--glow-1);
}

.flow-connector { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 85%, transparent); }

.flow-item.active .flow-dot {
  background: var(--grad);
  border-color: transparent;
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px var(--glow-1);
  animation: dot-pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.flow-item.done .flow-dot {
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--ok), #34d399);
  border-color: transparent;
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok) 55%, transparent);
}

.flow-item.done + .flow-connector {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-1), var(--accent-2));
}

.board-option {
  background: var(--glass);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 80%, transparent);
  transition: transform 0.25s var(--ease-out), border-color 0.25s ease,
    box-shadow 0.3s ease, background 0.25s ease;
}

.board-option:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2) 55%, transparent);
}

.board-option.selected {
  border-color: transparent;
  background: linear-gradient(
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--row-selected) 70%, transparent),
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--row-selected) 70%, transparent)) padding-box,
    var(--grad-soft) border-box;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2) 40%, transparent),
    0 10px 26px -16px var(--glow-1);
}

.spinner {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 55%, transparent);
  border-top-color: var(--accent-2);
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--glow-1);
}

.flash-done-msg {
  box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok) 60%, transparent);
}

@keyframes dot-pulse {
  0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--glow-1); }
  50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px transparent; }
}

  <script>
/* Light/dark theme. Applies <html data-theme="dark|light">, persists the
   choice in localStorage and falls back to the OS preference. */
(function () {
  var KEY = "obi-theme";

  function initialTheme() {
    return "light";
  }

  function apply(theme) {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", theme);
    var btn = document.getElementById("theme-toggle");
    if (btn) {
      var next = theme === "light" ? "dark" : "light";
      btn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Switch to " + next + " mode");
      btn.setAttribute("title", "Switch to " + next + " mode");
    }
  }

  apply(initialTheme());

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    var theme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme") === "light" ? "light" : "dark";
    apply(theme);
    var btn = document.getElementById("theme-toggle");
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var next = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme") === "light" ? "dark" : "light";
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, next);
      } catch (e) {
        /* ignore */
      }
      apply(next);
    });
  });
})();

/* Responsive navbar: toggle the burger menu on small screens. */
(function () {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    var navbar = document.querySelector(".navbar");
    var toggle = document.getElementById("nav-toggle");
    if (!navbar || !toggle) return;
    toggle.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var open = navbar.classList.toggle("nav-open");
      toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
      toggle.setAttribute("aria-label", open ? "Close navigation menu" : "Open navigation menu");
    });
    navbar.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      if (!navbar.classList.contains("nav-open")) return;
      var link = e.target.closest && e.target.closest("a");
      if (link) {
        navbar.classList.remove("nav-open");
        toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
        toggle.setAttribute("aria-label", "Open navigation menu");
      }
    });
  });
})();
  </script>

  <script>
/* Reveal-on-scroll entrance animations (ui-flashy branch, exploratory).
   Adds a staggered fade/slide-up to page blocks. Everything stays visible
   if IntersectionObserver is missing or the user prefers reduced motion. */
(function () {
  var SELECTORS = [
    '.hero',
    '.feature-card',
    '.step',
    '.card',
    '.warning',
    '.faq',
    '.wizard-card',
    '.flash-card',
    '.test-group',
    '.tool-header',
    '.uploader-header'
  ].join(', ');

  if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;
  if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;

  var els = document.querySelectorAll(SELECTORS);
  if (!els.length) return;

  document.documentElement.classList.add('js-reveal');
  els.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add('reveal'); });

  var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
    entries.forEach(function (entry) {
      if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
      var el = entry.target;
      var delay = 0;
      if (el.dataset.revealDelay) {
        delay = parseInt(el.dataset.revealDelay, 10) || 0;
      } else {
        var parent = el.parentElement;
        if (parent) {
          var idx = Array.prototype.indexOf.call(parent.children, el);
          delay = Math.min(idx * 70, 490);
        }
      }
      if (delay) el.style.transitionDelay = delay + 'ms';
      el.classList.add('revealed');
      io.unobserve(el);
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -6% 0px' });

  els.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
})();
  </script>
